# Wyrd

> Wyrd is open-source AI assurance and verification infrastructure. Verify AI systems before and after release, with verdicts you can trace, reproduce, and audit.

## Home

- [Wyrd docs](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/): the docs home, with a link to each published section.

## Machine-readable schemas

- [llms-full.txt](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/llms-full.txt): this index plus the JSON Schema of every Card kind.
- [Card and API JSON Schemas](https://github.com/bohmian-ai/wyrd/tree/main/crates/wyrd-spec/schemas): the source schemas generated from `wyrd-spec`.
